soma_literal: Right arm bends and lifts forward across the abdomen, hand turning thumb-up with fingers curled, pauses before the pelvis, then lowers once as the torso tilts right.
g1_literal: The right arm bends once, lifting the forearm forward and diagonally across the torso to chest height, then lowers palm-up before straightening beside the hip.

soma_literal: Both arms lift forward with elbows bent, bringing curved fingers together directly before the eyes, hold this position briefly, then lower apart toward the sides.
g1_literal: Both arms lift forward from the sides, elbows bending as curved hands converge in front of and above the forehead, briefly hold, then lower.

soma_literal: Both hands rise forward to face level with elbows bent, repeatedly flexing and extending the index and middle fingers while held apart.
g1_literal: Both arms rise forward with elbows bent, holding hands in front of the face as the index and middle fingers repeatedly bend and straighten, then lower.

soma_literal: Right arm lifts forward from the side to eye level, with elbow slightly bent, wrist flexed and fingers hanging downward, pauses, then lowers.
g1_literal: The right arm lifts forward and bends, positioning a flexed wrist and downward-pointing fingers near the face, holds briefly, then lowers.

soma_literal: Both forearms lift forward to chest height; the right wrist bends downward with curved fingers above the partially closed left hand, then both lower.
g1_literal: Both arms lift forward with elbows bent, forearms crossing before the upper chest; the right hand rises near the face as this pose is maintained.

soma_literal: Right arm bends upward and forward, bringing a closed fist near the shoulder, then extends forward as the hand opens and lowers.
g1_literal: The right arm lifts forward with the elbow bent, bringing gathered fingertips near the face; the pose is held briefly before the fingers spread and arm lowers.

soma_literal: Both forearms lift forward to chest height with elbows bent, while the curled hands repeatedly alternate vertically, one hovering above the other.
g1_literal: Both arms lift forward with bent elbows, while the separated hands repeatedly alternate vertically in front of the torso, then both arms lower.

soma_literal: Right arm lifts forward from the side to shoulder height as the elbow straightens and fingers curl, briefly holds, then lowers again.
g1_literal: The right arm bends and lifts forward from beside the hip to shoulder height, pauses with an open hand, then lowers.

soma_literal: The right hand and forearm lift forward to rest against the right side of the head while the head tilts right and torso bends, hold, then lower.
g1_literal: Right arm lifts with elbow bent until the hand is slightly forward of and beside the face, thumb and index forming a ring, holds, then lowers.

soma_literal: The right arm bends and lifts forward, holding a curled hand just before the mouth for several moments, then lowers.
g1_literal: The right arm bends forward and upward, holding the hand close before the face as fingers shift from curled to partly extended, then lowers.
